title: Introduce Cost Broker: declarative batch/cache policies & quant-profile linter
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Customers consistently ship suboptimal batching/cache/quant defaults per-route which increases per-token unit economics and causes unpredictable latency spikes. This PR introduces a lightweight, declarative 'Cost Broker' service and a quantization-profile linter to provide safe, auditable defaults and automated checks before rollout.

What this PR does (high level): Adds a Cost Broker component that consumes a small YAML policy (per-tenant/per-route selectors) and synthesizes recommended runtime defaults (batch size targets, KV-cache TTL/prefix heuristics, and quant profile hints). The broker is purely advisory by default and exposes: 1) rictl preview CLI (dry-run) 2) a control-plane API for safe-preview and apply 3) telemetry hooks for per-route unit-econ estimates. Also adds a standalone quant-profile linter that validates candidate quantization settings against service-level loss budgets (per-model tolerances) and rejects profiles likely to regress BLEU/QA metrics beyond configured thresholds.

Design notes: Policies are intentionally terse: selector + worklet. Selector matches by route regex, model family, and traffic class. Worklets are ordered and can emit overrides for batching, cache, and quant recommendations. Runtime respects that Cost Broker recommendations are tagged as 'advisory' until an operator flips 'applyMode' for a tenant. The linter runs as part of CI for quant-profile PRs and as part of the control-plane preview endpoint.

APIs and config: - pkg/costbroker/policy_schema.go: YAML schema and validator - cmd/rictl/cost-broker.go: preview/apply CLI - api/controlplane/costbroker/v1: preview/apply endpoints - infra/helm/cost-broker-values.yaml: defaults for installation

Telemetry and safety: Adds metrics (costbroker.recommendation.applied, costbroker.preview.estimate_usd_per_1k_tokens, quant.linter.rejects) and tracing spans. Recommendations include a delta estimate (expected USD change) and risk score (0-100). The linter emits a compact report with per-check violations and an aggregated risk score.

Testing and rollout plan: Unit tests for policy matcher and linter. E2E harness runs a synthetic workload against the preview endpoint and verifies that 'applyMode=false' leaves runtime unchanged. Rollout plan: feature-gate = off by default; gradual enabling via console + Linear task for first 5 tenants. Backout: Cost Broker changes are control-plane only and reversible; no runtime-breaking migrations.

Related: ENG-2543 implements the policy matcher proto; PM-87 defines the UX for preview/apply in Console.

Notes: Kept runtime surface minimal — runtime only reads final overrides from standard config path. Changes are designed to be conservative and operator-driven.
commits_summary: 1) Add policy schema and parser (pkg/costbroker) 2) Implement preview/apply endpoints + CLI (cmd/rictl) 3) Add quant-profile linter and unit tests (tools/linter) 4) Hook telemetry and tracing (internal/telemetry) 5) Docs and example policies (docs/operations/cost-broker.md, examples/cost-broker) 6) Helm values and chart tweaks for optional install

release_notes: Add Cost Broker control-plane service (advisory batch/cache/quant recommendations), a quant-profile linter integrated into CI, rictl preview/apply for safe rollouts, and example policies. Feature is behind a feature gate and off by default.
notes_for_ops: Install via helm chart: set costBroker.enabled=true and configure kms if you want signed previews. Default mode is advisory; to apply recommendations set applyMode=tenant-level true. Linter runs inside CI; to opt-out for a repo add tools/quant-linter:skip label.
example_policy_yaml:
apiVersion: redwood/v1
kind: CostPolicy
metadata:
  tenant: acme-corp
spec:
  - selector:
      route: '^/chat/.*'
      model_family: 'llama-2'
      traffic_class: 'interactive'
    worklet:
      batch_size_target: 8
      kv_cache:
        prefix_ttl_seconds: 30
        enable_prefix_pruning: true
      quant_hints:
        prefer: 'int8'
        max_accuracy_loss_pct: 1.5
  - selector:
      route: '^/embeddings/.*'
    worklet:
      batch_size_target: 64
      kv_cache:
        enable: false
changelog_summary: New: Cost Broker advisory control-plane, rictl preview/apply. New: quant-profile linter and CI job. Docs: operational guide and example policies. Telemetry: costbroker.* and quant.linter.* metrics added.
user_impact: Low by default (advisory). Operators enabling applyMode will start to see per-route unit-econ diffs in telemetry; we recommend staged rollout for high-volume tenants.
testing_notes: Included unit tests for matcher/linter and an e2e smoke job that exercises preview against a synthetic workload (tests/e2e/cost-broker-preview.yaml). CI shows all green after fixes.
security_considerations: Recommendations are advisory and stored in control plane; secrets (KMS-signed previews) optional. Ensure RBAC allows only operators to flip applyMode. Linter is deterministic and runs in CI to avoid human error.
manual_steps_after_merge: 1) Helm upgrade with costBroker.enabled=true for desired clusters. 2) Run rictl cost-broker preview --policy examples/cost-broker/sample-policy.yaml to validate. 3) Flip applyMode for an initial tenant behind a feature gate.
